label: Fixed equal average of strongest spectral and local-context models
formula: p=.5*p_V167+.5*p_V178; identical outer folds; average5fold test after per-fold fusion
rationale: V167 has strongest earlier KS; V178 wins4/5folds and improves AUC. Test complementary learned risk corrections, without fitting weights on outer labels.

label: Bounded additive spectral and local-context logit residuals over V25
rationale: Preserve full existing correction amplitudes instead of halving them through averaging, with a prespecified logit cap. Residual independence is not assumed; this is not claimed to be formal Bayesian evidence fusion.
